stem:
Soham draws the life cycle of a bean plant for homework.

Which sequence and idea are correct?

options.text: New bean seeds form inside the leaves after flowering.
Seed → germination → leaves → flowers → pods with seeds; those seeds can start a new generation.
Seed → germination → leaves → pods → flowers → death.
Seed → germination → leaves → flowers; the cycle is then complete with no pods needed.

teacher.key_rationale: The bean cycle runs seed to germination, leaves, flowers, then fruits/pods with seeds that can grow into new plants. Seeds do not form in leaves; flowers come before pods; stopping at flowers omits seed formation.
